text: dsh-session-repair 是面向 DSH 的会话日志修复工具插件，通过工具接口提供日志扫描与修复。它检查 sessions 目录中的压缩会话日志，报告帧数、行数、头部格式、解析错误和未知事件；需要修复时，可将单帧日志重建为逐行独立帧，并把不认识的事件标记为可忽略。修复前会备份文件并验证重建结果。适合需要排查或恢复 DSH 会话日志的用户。运行需要本机可用的 zstd 命令行工具。

dsh-session-repair adds tools to inspect and repair DSH session logs. It reports log format issues and can rebuild compressed frames, mark unknown events as ignorable, back up files, and verify repairs. It requires the local zstd command-line tool.
想检查 DSH 会话日志有没有损坏或格式问题
帮我扫描本机的 DSH session 日志并汇总异常
怎么找出不能被旧版 harness 读取的会话事件
dsh-session-repair 的功能「扫描会话日志」：session_repair_scan 检查压缩日志并汇总问题、提示、解析错误和未知事件；支持指定目录及详细输出。
dsh-session-repair 的功能「修复会话日志」：调用 session_repair_fix 修复检测到的问题，可限定会话 ID 或补充已知事件类型。工具备份原文件、重建压缩帧并核对帧数后替换日志。
@snow-the/dsh-session-repair README · dsh-session-repair：Scans and repairs DSH session logs (`~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.jsonl.zstd`).

@snow-the/dsh-session-repair README · Fixes：- **Single-frame corrupt logs** — a session file re-compressed as one zstd frame breaks
  the harness at boot (`first frame is not exactly one header line`). The plugin rebuilds
  the log in the canonical multi-frame layout: one JSON line per zstd frame.
- **Unknown event types** — events written by newer harness builds (e.g. `llm/failover`)
  make older harnesses refuse the whole log (`SessionFormatUnsupportedError`). The plugin
  marks such events `"ignorable": true` (the event is kept; the harness skips it).

@snow-the/dsh-session-repair README · Tools：- `session_repair_scan` — read-only report of every session log: zstd frame count,
  line count, header validity, parse errors, unknown event types.
- `session_repair_fix` — repairs problem logs (or one `sessionId`). Backs up each file as
  `<file>.bak-repair-<timestamp>` before replacing it, then verifies the rebuilt layout
  (frames == lines). Restart the harness afterwards.

@snow-the/dsh-session-repair README · Safety：- Never writes in place: backup → rebuild to temp → verify → atomic rename.
- Scan is strictly read-only.
